name: Kali and Ko
description:
About This Game

Kali & Ko is a cooperative adventure game where players take on the roles of Kali and Ko, a pair of junior explorers on their first major assignment.

What begins as a routine mission to map a newly discovered island and make contact with the crew of seasoned explorers sent to the island a before you, quickly escalates into the adventure of a lifetime.

After becoming stranded, the pair discovers the crew and the island itself are in danger due to a corrupting force that's causing havoc on the island. Kali and Ko must work together to save the crew, defeat the corruption and find a way off the island.

Features

  • Dynamic Difficulty - Play with anyone, regardless of skill. A veteran gamer and a total novice can play together without frustration. The game scales enemy aggression and puzzle complexity for the players.

  • Explore an island from sun-soaked beaches to the mysterious Shadowy forest, discover the 4 temples and save the missing crew members

  • Catalog the unique flora and fauna you find on your journey. The island is alive with curious creatures to discover, and as junior explorers you'll want to do a good job cataloging all that you find!

  • Conquer four massive temples featuring layered challenges involving stealth, rhythm, precision jumping, and environmental manipulation.

  • Face off against corrupted Guardians and rescue the missing crew members

Cooperative Play

In Kali & Ko, you are a team. Our unique Item-Swapping Mechanic means only one player can hold a core tool at a time. You’ll need to toss items back and forth mid-puzzle and mid-combat to solve the island’s temples.
